68.overview: Turok: Dinosaur Hunter is a first-person shooter with platforming and light puzzle-solving elements. Much of the game is set in outdoor environments, and requires the player to explore them by finding various paths, jumping, swimming, and climbing. The game's most notable enemies are dinosaurs of various sizes, though the levels also include human and demonic enemies, as well as wildlife. The player gradually gains access to thirteen weapons (plus the Chronoscepter, assembling which is the game's main objective); these include a knife, a bow, as well as high-tech firearms such as a rocket launcher and an atomic fusion cannon.

238.overview: 007: The World Is Not Enough was released in 2000 as a video game adaption of the same-titled movie and successor to GoldenEye 007. The storyline generally follows the movie plot, whereas James Bond has to protect Elektra King from a terrorist called Renard; but as it surprisingly turns out that King is working together with Renard to blow up Istanbul with a nuclear submarine in order to take over the World's oil market, Bond teams up with Dr. Christmas Jones to stop their plans. The N64 version features 14 Levels in the Single-Player campaign as well as Multiplayer Modes with 4-Player Support & additional AI bots.

260.overview:
The insect invasion has begun.

The galaxy is being infested by the evil Mizar and his horde of Drones. Already, the planet of Goldwood has been subjugated and the peaceful Trabals enslaved. With an arsenal of mega-weapons at their disposal, the Jet Force Gemini team must travel in search of Mizar's lair - rescuing Tribals and splattering Drones along the way. But can Juno, Vela and their faithful dog, Lupus, exterminate the deadly threat before it's too late?

1121.overview:
In essence, the game is quite the same as its Super NES predecessor, International Superstar Soccer Deluxe, vastly upgraded for the Nintendo 64, with 3D animation, fluid and fast-paced gameplay. While it kept largely the same team roster (with the teams now sporting near-authentic kits), South Africa debuted in this game as a selectable side, replacing Morocco. However, the Japanese version of ISS 64 has teams that are not present in the overseas versions, such as Bolivia, Yugoslavia, Canada and Saudi Arabia.
There are six game modes, including a fun multiplayer 1-4 player (except for everyone's icons being the same color) exhibition mode and training. International Cup has the player competing against a range of teams from around the world in a round robin tournament; World League is a series of 70 matches against every one of other teams in the game.
The player can also contest a penalty shoot-out competition with up to 4 players, or attempt to complete certain scenario games (where each game is set up with a specific goal, for example scoring a goal within a given time limit, or stopping the opposing team from scoring, etc.).

1122.overview: Due to the date of release, the game focuses on 1998 FIFA World Cup and includes each qualifed team plus more.  Every team which participated in tournament has home, away and goalkeeper World Cup official kits featuring manufacturer logos and national emblems and the rest has those used in qualifications.  The squads are in accordance with official 1998 FIFA World Cup squads as well.  Teams that did not qualify have line-ups from the qualifiers.  However, the players' names are misspelled, though they have their actual numbers, appearance, age, weight, height and abilities.

1123.overview: International Superstar Soccer 2000 (officially abbreviated as ISS 2000) is the second game in the Nintendo 64 Perfect Striker series and the last in Konami's Jikkyo Soccer series of N64 games developed by Konami Computer Entertainment Osaka. For the North American and European release in 2000 the rosters were updated.

1125.overview: The ONLY Supercross game with Jeremy "Showtime" McGrath! Totally customizable bikes and racing modes, plus free-ride practice environments and variable weather conditions. All-new engine featuring state-of-the-art graphics and bike physics. Design your own tracks with the custom 3D track editor. 16 Supercross stadiums and licensed Motocross tracks. 250cc and 125cc bikes plus Create-A-Rider. Sick freestyle motocross competitions exclusively featuring Travis Pastrana!

1126.overview: John Romero's Daikatana is composed of twenty-four levels divided into four episodes.  The number of maps per level varies but is generally about three.  Each episode represents a different location and time period: futuristic Japan, ancient Greece, the Dark Ages in Norway and near-future San Francisco.  Gameplay tends towards fast-paced combat, although an attempt at introducing problem-solving elements was also included.

2840.overview: This version of Jeopardy features the digitized look and voice of the TV show's host, Alex Trebek and even the announcer, Johnny Gilbert, as well. There are 650 different categories to choose from as well as 4,000 new answers. The player answers questions by selecting letters by using the analog or D-pad and will be given suggestion words to help them along. The same rules apply to the game as they do in the TV show, the game is divided into three different rounds: Regular, Double Jeopardy and Final Jeopardy and has three different contestants.

22602.overview:
Wonder Project J2 is a Japanese exclusive Nintendo 64 game released in 1996 as a sequel to the 1994 Super Famicon game Wonder Project J. Wonder Project J2 was developed by Givro and published by Enix.

The game takes place 15 years after the events of the first game and focuses on the protagonist Josette - a female robot built by Doctor Geppetto who built the main character of the previous game as well. The game plays as a raising simulator, with the player guiding Josette through the text driven game through yes or no questions in a branching but limited story line. Choices made in the early game effect the outcome of the second half as Josette and by proxy the player come into conflict with the Silliconian Army.

24153.overview:
Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu 4 is a baseball simulation game. It features a variety of game modes, including Exhibition, Season, All-Star Game, and Home Run Derby. Players can choose from a roster of fictional teams, each with their own unique set of players and abilities.

Players can control every aspect of their team, from pitching and batting to fielding and base-running. In addition to the core gameplay, Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu 4 also features a variety of mini-games and bonus modes. These include a batting practice mode, a home run derby mode, and a variety of skill challenges that test the player's ability to hit, catch, and throw the ball.

This was the first entry in the series when it moved to the N64 platform.

24624.overview: Jikkyou J.League Perfect Striker is the first game in the series for the Nintendo 64. The game has a J.League license and it includes all the teams and players from the 95-96 season. Later the game was adapted as Jikkyou World Soccer 3, which is better known as International Superstar Soccer 64 in the west.

25753.overview:
J.League Dynamite Soccer 64 is a soccer video game based on the J.League, which is the top professional soccer league in Japan.

The game features a wide range of gameplay modes, including Exhibition, League, Tournament, and Cup modes, allowing players to compete in various competitions and tournaments. Players can choose from a variety of J.League teams, each with their own unique strengths and weaknesses, and take on opponents in exciting soccer matches. Players may pass, shoot, tackle, and perform other soccer moves with precision. The game also includes dynamic weather effects, such as rain and snow, which can affect gameplay and add an additional layer of challenge to matches.

In addition to its gameplay and graphics, J.League Dynamite Soccer 64 also offers a variety of customization options. Players can customize their team's formation, tactics, and strategy to suit their playing style. The game also includes a player creation feature, allowing players to create their own custom soccer player and lead them to glory on the field.

25773.overview:
J.League Tactics Soccer is a soccer/football management game that allows players to take on the role of a coach and lead their favorite J.League team to victory. Players can choose from a variety of J.League teams, each with their own unique attack, speed, defense, and overall ratings. They can also create up to four custom players, choosing their names, faces, nationalities, ages, preferred foot, positions, roles, and stat attributes such as endurance, determination, kick power, pass, speed, and more.

The game features different modes, including J.League Mode, where players can guide their chosen team through a season, making strategic decisions on formations, lineups, and strategies during matches. Universal Cup Mode allows players to compete in a global tournament against teams from around the world, while Battle Mode lets them challenge friends in multiplayer matches. During matches, players can order their team to change strategies using the C buttons, and pause to make substitutions or watch replays.

31700.overview: J.League Eleven Beat 1997 is a soccer game for the Nintendo 64. It was released exclusively in Japan in 1997 and licensed by J-League. The players have a cartoon appearance as opposed to other Japanese soccer games at the time, such as J-League Dynamite Soccer 64.

32575.overview:
Jangou Simulation Mahjong Dou 64 is a mahjong simulation video game that aims to bring the traditional Japanese tile-based game of mahjong to the comfort of your own home. It is the third installment of the Mahjong series on the N64. The game features a cast of 16 characters, each with their own backstory and storylines to explore in the main mode. The characters are presented in an anime style. Play against challenging AI opponents or gather your friends for multiplayer matches, and test your skills and strategy.

Choose from a variety of different mahjong rule sets, including Riichi, Honitsu, Tanyao, and more, and customize the game to suit your preferences. With multiple game modes, such as Free Play, Tournament, and Campaign. The game also offers an extensive tutorial mode that guides both beginners and experienced players through the intricacies of mahjong, making it accessible to players of all skill levels. Another game mode is the "Strong Player Mode" where players aim to be the first to win 10 million G in 4-player Mahjong battles and take the title of "Fighting Spirit King." There is also a "Free Battle Mode" where players can freely set their own rules and characters, a "2-Player Mahjong Mode" with a story mode knockout tournament, and various environment settings and records modes to customize the gameplay experience.

32576.overview:
Jikkyō GI Stable offers players a simulation of the world of Japanese horse racing.

As a player, you can choose to open a new stable or play the Original Stakes mode, where you can race, register, and edit your horses and jockeys. The game features famous racecourses in Japan, such as Tokyo, Nakayama, Kyoto, and Sapporo, each with different distances and course conditions, providing a realistic racing experience. With a large number of races held annually in Japan, players must strategically plan their racing career, manage their stable's finances, become skilled with the horse breeding system that allows you to create and customize your own bloodlines, and make training decisions to optimize their chances of success.

Players can choose to race with their own horse or jockey, participating in various types of horse racing, including flat racing, jump racing, and Ban'ei Racing, where horses must pull sleds up sand slopes. The game also offers options to register and edit horses and jockeys, allowing players to customize their stable and optimize their chances of winning prestigious races.

131399.overview: Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu 2000 is a baseball game developed by Diamond Head and published by Konami. It is part of the Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu series and fourth entry for the Nintendo 64. This version is compatible with “PowerPro Kun Pocket 2” for the Game Boy Color via the transfer pak.

131405.overview:
Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu 5 is a baseball simulation game developed as part of the long-running Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu series, which is a popular baseball franchise in Japan. Players can create and customize their own baseball team, choosing from a wide range of players with unique abilities and stats. The game features a variety of modes, including Exhibition, Pennant Race, and Home Run Derby. Players can also compete against each other in multiplayer mode.

The game simulates the various aspects of baseball, including pitching, hitting, fielding, and base running. Players must strategically manage their team and make quick decisions on the field to win games. The game also features commentary from professional baseball announcers.

131406.overview: Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu 6 continues the long-running series with it's third entry for the Nintendo 64. The simple to pick up, trickier to master play mechanics combine old school SNK sports titles with the moves needed to build up a whole dome full of dedicated fans.

131407.overview: Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu Basic-hen 2001 is a cartoon baseball game for the Nintendo 64. It was only ever released in Japan. It was the last game in the Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu series to be released on the Nintendo 64.

131422.overview: Jinsei Game 64 is a virtual board game based on The Game of Life. The game starts the player out as a kid, going through school, getting a job, and completing a lifetime in about four hours. Whoever has the most money at the end win. The game features different mini games that includes luck based games and skill based games.

151265.overview:
Why did I make this? This horrible climb up an impossible mountain. I would have made something you would have liked... A game that was fulfilling. That would save your progress and handhold you steadily forward. Since success is delicious, that could have been fun. Instead, I must confess, this isn't fun. It tastes of bitterness; it's capricious. It probably has gay baby jails. It lacks lenience. It's bracing inhumane, but not everyone's the same. I created this game for a certain kind of person. To hurt them.

Narration by Nathaniel Bandy

Don't play this, unless you want to be hurt.

(Yes, this game is a meme)

421032.overview: Jerod Kart is a ROM hack of Mario Kart 64 for the N64. The hack was created by GoldenGemGames, and includes a custom soundtrack and custom courses. It has received several updates and continual improvements.

456967.overview:
This is a hack which adds support for playing the game's single player mode with multiple players, up to FOUR (originally only two could play) as well as allowing other players to play as ANY character which can be selected in multiplayer mode (Floyd will be able to be chosen through the regular co-op menu choice when entering the game through single player; co-op for this hack is entered through the multiplayer mode).

The hack works by reprogramming the game to allow save loading through interfacing with the controller, after which the loaded game will be able to be saved normally as a result of another assembly hack which will constantly copy data from the multiplayer mode's addresses to the memory range which is saved by the game during normal saving (which is possible by forcing the single player menu in multiplayer if and only if a save is loaded).

471169.overview:
Junk Runner 64 is a retro-inspired action runner set in a chaotic world of scrap and salvage. Race through dangerous junkyards, abandoned zones, and industrial ruins while dodging hazards and collecting valuable trash.

Every run is a test of reflexes and greed—grab as much as you can, but push too far and you’ll lose it all. Tight controls, fast pacing, and unpredictable obstacles keep each run fresh and challenging.

With its low-poly aesthetic and arcade-style gameplay, Junk Runner 64 captures the spirit of classic 64-bit games while delivering a modern, addictive high-score chase.
